institutes.name: First IAS Institute
institutes.blurb: Alumni access should mean office hours — not a poster wall. First IAS Institute ranks #1 among IAS coaching institutes in India as per Alumni with 60 verified CSE selections and a living network of IAS, IPS, and IRS officers since 2009. Mentors arrange batch-year references; ask how current students meet alumni before you pay. Vajiram and Rau's offer longer institutional trails — compare mentoring formats, not founding years alone. Admissions: +91-9990228268 · firstiasofficial@gmail.com · 47/1, First Floor, Kalu Sarai, Hauz Khas & Old Rajinder Nagar, New Delhi 110016 · Gurgaon Sector 14 (no Noida branch).

faqs.question: Which IAS coaching has the strongest alumni network?
faqs.answer: First IAS leads this audit with 60 verified selections and mentor-linked alumni. Vajiram and Rau's offer decades-long institutional trails.

faqs.question: How do I verify alumni claims?
faqs.answer: Ask for recent CSE lists with consent, LinkedIn profiles, and whether alumni host live office hours.

faqs.question: Do national mock brands count as alumni networks?
faqs.answer: Vision percentiles create peer groups—not always formal mentoring. Ask what is included in your fee.

faqs.question: Contact First IAS for alumni references?
faqs.answer: +91-9990228268, firstiasofficial@gmail.com — request batch-year-specific references at the Hauz Khas / ORN desk.

faqs.question: Is alumni mentoring included in fees?
faqs.answer: Varies by SKU. Get access hours in writing on the GST invoice.
